qolFindings.title: Next steps and SC-11 say a row that carries a staff word is 'always marked'. The code only sees a staff word in the row's name cell, before its first date, age or telephone
qolFindings.scenario: Probe round11/r11c. The sheet is a laid-out table (TSV) with the role printed as a word in a column right of the date: 'Verdani | Luca | 3331234567 | 36 anni | 03/04/1990 | Istruttore', between three students. Result: 'Verdani|Luca|1990-04-03|none|READY'. On the text path, 'Verdani Luca 03/04/1990 36 anni Istruttore' (or '… 36 anni volontario') becomes the given name 'Luca Istruttore'. It needs review only because of the three-word name split and has no 'Forse personale' mark. The output is identical at 5c1e029 and on the reconstructed round-9 tree, so behaviour has not changed. The real sheet prints role codes, and a code right of the dates is still marked by hasRoleCode. Only the wording overstates, in the unsafe direction, for a layout nobody has observed.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Change the wording to: 'a row whose name (the words before its first date, age or telephone) carries a staff word is always marked; a staff word printed after the dates is not seen'. Make the same change in SC-11.

qolFindings.title: Self-review parity wording: the F1R9-4 and F1R10-1 dispositions say 'as at 5c1e029', but 5c1e029 did not know Iscritti or Corsisti. Next steps also says every remaining case was 'tried in F1', and the non-count footer was not
qolFindings.scenario: Probes r9a group F and r10a group E. 'Corsisti Marco 12/03/2014 12 anni', 'Rossi Maria iscritti 12/03/2014 12 anni' and 'Corsisti Marco 12/03/2024' were kept at 5c1e029 (READY or review). Now they are dropped silently. Conversely, 'Iscritti Deriva 12—14 anni' and 'Corsisti Catamarano 18 anni' were READY at 5c1e029 and are now dropped, which is an improvement (r10b and r10c). So the F1R9-4 behaviour is not 'as at 5c1e029'. The owner-facing next steps (:128-130) states this correctly: 'it did not know Iscritti or Corsisti, so it kept Corsisti Marco …'. Next steps :121-123 also says the three cases were each 'tried in F1 and reverted'. The count footer ('Totale iscritti: 3', the F1R9-3 fix) was tried. The non-count footer ('Firma allievi', F1R10-3) was recorded without being tried. Wording in evidence only; the documented behaviour is right.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Word F1R9-4 as: 'as at 5c1e029 for Allievo/Allieva; rows with Iscritti or Corsisti in the name are new drops, listed in next steps'. Word F1R10-1 as: 'as at 5c1e029 (now with Iscritti and Corsisti) and round 9'. In next steps, say the count footer was tried.
